zh-CN.title: 更顺畅的足迹查看与共享
items: 修复系统消息的足迹入口与成员头像排列，“我”改用文字颜色突出
打卡历史展示成员与国家，点击地图地区可查看打卡成员
聊天中直接进入已共享足迹，首次共享需确认，停止共享收进面板设置

en.title: Smoother footprint viewing and sharing
items: Fixed footprint shortcuts and avatar alignment; Me now uses a text accent
Check-in history includes members and countries; tap a region to see who visited
Shared maps open directly from chats, with consent before sharing and sharing controls inside the panel
